original_benchmark.notes: The reference agent is one headless Claude Code session per paper (baselines/agent_claude_code/run_agent.py): seven built-in tools, the task card appended to the system prompt, a 30-minute wall clock. The benchmark lists 292 scorable papers out of a 329-paper measured-limit pool. For three of the 292 the scorer cannot grade any answer (statuses excluded_gt and gt_unusable), and the leaderboard removes such papers from its denominator.

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity has not been run yet. Planned subset: 30 tasks stratified by coupling type with a fixed seed, generated with --split parity. Excluded: three papers the scorer cannot grade; see README.
